definitions.short: to germinate , i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make ) flourish ; also (of words), to utter
definitions.full: H5107. nub [ נוּב ] verb bear fruit (poetry) (Aramaic נוֺבָא fruit (rare)); — Qal Imperfect יָנוּב Psa 62:11 ; Prov 10:31 ; יְנוּבוּן Psa 92:15 ; — only figurative, absolute of righteous under figure of tree 92:15 ; יָנוּב כִּי חַיִל 62:11 if wealth beareth fruit ; Prov 10:31 חָכְמָה יָנוּב צַדִּיק מִּי beareth the fruit of wisdom. Po`l. Imperfect יְנוֺבֵב Zech 9:17 , יְנ וְתִירוֺשׁ ׳בַּחוּרִים בְּתֻלוֺת דָּגָן figurative for makes flourish .
